AKIRA TANA and Friends From Osaka @ BOP STOP

October 6 from 7:00pm - 9:30pm

AKIRA TANA and Friends From Osaka featuring organist, Atsuko Hashimoto and guitarist Yutaka Hashimoto are making their first appearance at Cleveland’s Bop Stop after performing at this year’s Monterey Jazz Festival on their way to three days at Lincon Center’s Dizzy’s in New York City. This trio is also celebrating a recent release, “Loving Burt Bacharach.”

This event will also be livestreamed on BOP STOP's Youtube Channel at showtime. Accessing the stream is free but donations are encouraged and directly support the band.
